name: Can Cork Floors Be Refinished? A Kirkland Homeowner's Guide
title-tag: Can Cork Floors Be Refinished? A Kirkland, WA Guide
meta-description: Solid cork tile can be lightly sanded; thin-veneer floating cork can't. How to tell which you have, why a $1.99/sq ft recoat is usually the right fix.
post-summary: February 19, 2027 · Solid glue-down cork tile can be lightly sanded and refinished; floating cork planks with a fiberboard core cannot. How to identify yours from a floor vent, why most tired cork floors need a recoat rather than a sand, and what Kirkland's two waves of cork installation mean for your floor.
